import openpyxl

def get_green_cells(file_path):
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
    ws = wb.active
    greens = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            fill = cell.fill
            if fill and fill.fgColor and hasattr(fill.fgColor, 'rgb') and fill.fgColor.rgb == 'FF00FF00':
                greens.append((cell.row, cell.column))
    return greens
